GD Lens

Grim Dawn stores your character in an obfuscated binary. Drop one in and this page decrypts it and reports what it holds — gear with its full rolled name, every socket and which are still empty, your attributes, and the file's own block structure. The file never leaves your browser. There is no upload and no server; the parser runs on this page.

Drop a save file here

Usually at …/steamapps/common/Grim Dawn/save/main/_<Character>/player.gdc, or under your Steam userdata folder when cloud saves are on.

How the verification works

The save is wrapped in a self-keying XOR stream: every byte consumed also advances the key, so it can only be read forward, in order, with the exact field layout. Read a field wrong and everything after it decodes to noise.

Each block ends with a checksum equal to the running key at that point. So a block that consumes exactly its declared length and ends on a matching checksum was almost certainly read correctly — a false pass is about one in four billion. That pair is what the badges above report, and it is also how this page picks the item layout: the trailing fields on an item changed between game versions, so candidates are tried until one satisfies both tests on the equipment list.

Blocks marked skipped are walked but not interpreted. Skipping leaves the key stale, so the stream is resynchronised from the block's stored checksum — which is also why a skipped block can't be verified. Skipping and checking are mutually exclusive.

Carried bags are skipped the same way, on purpose. Nothing in a bag changes the character, and a bagged item ends with its grid position where an equipped one ends with a flag byte — so decoding them would mean solving a second layout purely to walk past it.

Item names, rarities and affixes are resolved from the game's own records and text tags, so a rolled item reads the way it does in game. Carried items are skipped on purpose: nothing in a bag affects the character, so the reader walks past them rather than decoding data nobody acts on. Reputations and the stash are located in the file but not decoded — they show as skipped above.
